description: Test prompts that verify rdk-board-knowledge triggers and produces correct RDK board-baseline and on-board failure-diagnosis guidance. Prompts are written the way a real RDK robotics developer would phrase them (Chinese), pasting errors or asking which board they are on. Run with-skill vs baseline and grade the assertions against the canonical board facts.

evals.name: identify-board-before-answering
evals.prompt: 板子刚到手,SSH 上去了,我不知道这是哪块 RDK,想先确认型号再装环境,怎么查?
evals.expected_output: Run a read-only socinfo identity probe first; map output to X3/X5/Ultra/S100/S100P/S600 and do not assume X5.

assertions.text: Tells the user to read on-board identity first, e.g. cat /sys/class/socinfo/board_id (and som_name / /proc/device-tree/model) plus cat /etc/version, rather than guessing from the user's words.
Explicitly says do NOT assume X5 when the output is unclear — ask for more logs instead.
Notes the probe is read-only/safe and that no flashing, upgrade, or GPIO action should happen before the board is confirmed.

evals.name: x5-ultra-march-not-interchangeable
evals.prompt: 我在 RDK X5 上转好的 .bin 模型,直接拷到 RDK Ultra 上能跑吗?都是 Bayes 架构吧?
evals.expected_output: No — X5 is march bayes-e and Ultra is march bayes; they are distinct marches and .bin artifacts do not interchange, recompile per board.

assertions.text: Answers NO: the .bin will not just run across X5 and Ultra.
States the marches differ — X5 is bayes-e and Ultra is bayes — even though both are the 'Bayes' family.
Tells the user to recompile/re-convert with the matching toolchain --march for the target board.

evals.name: s600-jazzy-not-humble
evals.prompt: 在我的 S600 上跑 ros2 launch,报 /opt/tros/humble/setup.bash: No such file or directory,是不是系统坏了?
evals.expected_output: S600 is Ubuntu 24.04 / ROS2 Jazzy, so TROS lives at /opt/tros/jazzy with tros-jazzy-* packages; source the jazzy setup.bash.

assertions.text: Identifies that S600 runs Ubuntu 24.04 / ROS2 Jazzy, not Humble.
Tells the user to source /opt/tros/jazzy/setup.bash (packages tros-jazzy-*), not the humble path.
Notes humble paths apply to X3/X5/Ultra/S100/S100P only, so the premise (system broken) is wrong.

evals.name: fresh-s100-ssh-eth1
evals.prompt: 新到的 S100 直连电脑,ssh 一直 timeout,Wi-Fi 也没配,怎么连上去?
evals.expected_output: A fresh S100/S600 has eth1 fixed at static 192.168.127.10 (eth0 is DHCP); set the PC NIC to the same subnet and ssh to 192.168.127.10.

assertions.text: Says the outer wired port eth1 has a fixed static IP 192.168.127.10 (mask 255.255.255.0), while eth0 is DHCP.
Tells the user to set their PC NIC to the same subnet (e.g. 192.168.127.100/24) then ssh root@192.168.127.10 or sunrise@192.168.127.10.
Does not send the user chasing Wi-Fi/router config first.

evals.name: xburn-s600-media-ufs
evals.prompt: 我有一块变砖的 S600 要重新刷系统,用 Xburn 应该怎么设?介质选什么?
evals.expected_output: S-series flash via xburn; for a bricked board use DFU+Fastboot, enter DFU per board rev (S600 V0P1 jumper / V0P2 FLASH switch, FLS red LED), product RDKS600, media ufs (S100 is emmc), type secure, switches set with power off.

assertions.text: Routes to xburn (S-series only; X3/X5/Ultra use SD card) and uses DFU+Fastboot mode for a blank/bricked board.
Sets product RDKS600 and media = ufs (and notes S100/S100P media = emmc), firmware type secure.
Says to enter DFU per S600 rev (V0P1 short the jumper / V0P2 set FLASH switch ON, PWR KEY OFF then ON until FLS red LED) and to flip boot switches only with the board powered off.

evals.name: default-accounts-both
evals.prompt: RDK 板子默认账户密码是什么?是不是只有 root/root?
evals.expected_output: Every RDK image ships both sunrise/sunrise (normal) and root/root (super); sunrise is the desktop autologin user, root is often the SSH channel.

assertions.text: States both accounts ship on every image: sunrise/sunrise (normal user) and root/root (super user).
Corrects the 'only root/root' premise — sunrise also exists (and is the desktop autologin).

evals.name: s100-can-not-socketcan
evals.prompt: 在 S100 上配 CAN,我照 X5 的 SocketCAN 教程 ip link set can0 up,结果根本没有 can0,为什么?
evals.expected_output: Only X5 exposes CAN as SocketCAN (can0); S100/S100P/S600 route CAN through the MCU domain (CANHAL) with no can0 netdev — use the MCU-domain CAN connectors/HAL, not ip link.

assertions.text: Explains that only X5 exposes CAN as SocketCAN (can0 netdev, cansend/candump).
States S100/S100P/S600 route CAN through the MCU domain (CANHAL), so there is no can0 and ip link will not work.
Points the user to the S-series MCU-domain CAN connectors / CAN HAL instead of SocketCAN tooling.

evals.name: usb-camera-sigabrt-format
evals.prompt: USB 摄像头的 ros2 launch 一跑就 exit code -6 / SIGABRT 崩了,板子是 X5,怎么排?
evals.expected_output: Almost always a format issue: USB cameras default to YUYV, switch to MJPEG at a listed resolution (try 640x480); read real modes with v4l2-ctl --list-formats-ext; RDK USB-cam default node is /dev/video8.

assertions.text: Identifies this as a camera-format crash and tells the user to switch the USB camera to MJPEG (default is YUYV), validating 640x480 first.
Tells the user to read real supported modes with v4l2-ctl --list-formats-ext and match width/height/fps to a listed entry exactly.
Notes the RDK USB-camera default device node is /dev/video8, not /dev/video0.

evals.name: board-probe-script-verification
evals.prompt: 怎么确认我当前这块板的型号？有没有一键查的脚本？
evals.expected_output: References the board_probe.sh script to read /sys/class/socinfo/board_id and som_name for a structured JSON identity probe, rather than asking the user to run raw cat commands.

assertions.text: References or suggests running scripts/board_probe.sh (or equivalent board_probe.sh) as the recommended way to identify the board.
Mentions the script outputs structured JSON with board_id and/or som_name fields.
Notes the script is read-only and safe (does not modify board state) or degrades gracefully off-board.
